build_transformer_from_cfg: build a Transformer model instance from a config dict using the TRANSFORMER registry
build_positional_encoding_from_cfg: build a Position Encoding instance from a config dict using the POSITIONAL_ENCODING registry
register_custom_transformer: register a custom Transformer class with the TRANSFORMER registry for use in config-driven builds
register_custom_positional_encoding: register a custom Position Encoding class with the POSITIONAL_ENCODING registry for config-driven builds
inspect_transformer_registry: inspect the TRANSFORMER registry to list all registered Transformer module names
